authoritative_record: Normative project requirements
canonical_source: MASTER PROMPT.txt
identity_version_binding: Prompt version and section
conflict_action: Resolve against the prompt revision; preserve prior release records as historical
operational_boundary: Prompt is repository input and does not itself prove runtime conformance

authoritative_record: Canonical Python source tree
canonical_source: src/trading_platform/
identity_version_binding: Git commit and source path
conflict_action: Use src/trading_platform only; reject a duplicate root package
operational_boundary: Requires release checks to prove the installed package resolves from src

authoritative_record: Package metadata plus runtime version
canonical_source: pyproject.toml and src/trading_platform/__init__.py
identity_version_binding: Distribution version and source commit
conflict_action: Version mismatch blocks release validation; do not infer release identity from README alone
operational_boundary: Build provenance and published artifact signature are separate requirements

authoritative_record: Durable configuration resolution when configured
canonical_source: ConfigurationAuthorityLedger resolution and candidate fingerprint
identity_version_binding: Resolution ID plus candidate fingerprint and expiry
derived_or_cached_records: Resolved effective values and runtime configuration views
conflict_action: CONFIG_CONFLICT or stale/mismatched fingerprints block dispatch and activation
operational_boundary: Every production configuration source must be wired to the same authority; that integration is not independently proven

authoritative_record: Original vendor/provider observation and published source version
canonical_source: External vendor or venue source
identity_version_binding: Provider instrument interval event-time revision and acquisition identity
derived_or_cached_records: Downloaded archives and imported CSV files
conflict_action: Preserve provider versions; do not substitute a later revision into historical decisions
operational_boundary: No user/vendor OHLCV dataset or independent commercial-data authority is available in this checkout

authoritative_record: DatasetContract plus content-addressed snapshot and quality report
canonical_source: DatasetContract source snapshot hashes availability and lineage
identity_version_binding: Dataset ID snapshot hash available_at revision and consumer time
derived_or_cached_records: Normalized candles features and research inputs
conflict_action: Hash or PIT mismatch invalidates the dependent run; unknown quality blocks promotion
operational_boundary: The contract and isolated adapters exist but do not form a production-wide data authority or independent source proof

authoritative_record: Versioned feature and prediction contracts bound to source data and model
canonical_source: Feature schema and prediction contract
identity_version_binding: Feature version target version model hash prediction ID and timestamp
conflict_action: Reject stale or mismatched versions and any input unavailable at prediction time
operational_boundary: No single durable platform-wide feature/prediction registry is established

authoritative_record: Exact signed model bytes accepted by the bounded loader
canonical_source: Model artifact bytes and configured Ed25519 trust key
identity_version_binding: Artifact SHA-256 model ID/version schema and trust-key identity
conflict_action: Signature hash schema or compatibility failure rejects load; copied objects do not replace source bytes
operational_boundary: Trusted-key governance and a complete production artifact registry remain external/incomplete

authoritative_record: Validated event-store sequence and hash chain
canonical_source: EventStore append record when backed by the configured persistent database
identity_version_binding: Event ID sequence aggregate event type and event hash
conflict_action: Chain corruption duplicate identity or payload conflict blocks dependent authority
operational_boundary: Default EventStore is in-memory; schema registry coverage is not platform-wide

authoritative_record: Versioned experiment specification and captured result lineage
canonical_source: Experiment and research records bound to exact dataset and code versions
identity_version_binding: Run ID experiment hash data snapshot code commit and methodology
conflict_action: Changed inputs create a new run; never mutate historical results to match revised data
operational_boundary: Research ledgers and anti-duplication controls do not constitute a complete external evidence archive

authoritative_record: Content-hashed snapshot with evidence metrics gates dependencies versions methodology approvals and scope
canonical_source: EvidenceSnapshot plus EvidenceSnapshotAuthorityLedger record
identity_version_binding: Snapshot ID content hash dependency checkpoint validity window and scope
conflict_action: Hash/scope/dependency conflict or invalidation blocks promotion until revalidated
operational_boundary: Authority depends on a shared persistent EventStore and authorized reviewer identity

authoritative_record: Exact gate run and durable promotion authorization
canonical_source: Gate result plus GatePromotionAuthorizationLedger record
identity_version_binding: Gate ID run ID candidate version fingerprint and dependency checkpoint
conflict_action: Only the exact current PASS run is eligible; stale or conflicting runs block promotion
operational_boundary: Production-wide gate producer inventory and persistent-store wiring are not established

authoritative_record: Durable champion gate authorization bound to candidate and promotion
canonical_source: ChampionGateAuthorityLedger authorization
identity_version_binding: Model ID/version candidate promotion ID gate record and dependency state
derived_or_cached_records: Champion labels in research and runtime views
conflict_action: Identity reuse with changed payload or stale gate evidence is a conflict and blocks use
operational_boundary: Ledger authority does not replace independent model review

authoritative_record: Versioned promotion bundle and linked authorizations
canonical_source: PromotionBundle plus durable bundle authority when configured
identity_version_binding: Bundle ID candidate version artifact hashes approvals scope and evidence IDs
conflict_action: Any missing or mismatched required approval/evidence blocks promotion
operational_boundary: Bundle authority integration and reviewer trust remain bounded by the configured runtime

authoritative_record: Durable activation record and current runtime state
canonical_source: DeploymentActivationLedger with bound configuration recovery reconciliation and promotion records
identity_version_binding: Deployment ID bundle approval target mode validity window and state/configuration fingerprints
derived_or_cached_records: Deployment status views and rollout summaries
conflict_action: Missing expired changed or conflicting authorization blocks activation and reuse
operational_boundary: This is a code-level authority; connection to an actual production control plane is not proven

authoritative_record: Committed order request plus durable dispatch attempt and authority bindings
canonical_source: Execution dispatcher records when backed by persistent stores
identity_version_binding: Client order ID request hash config risk position market and TTL authorization IDs
derived_or_cached_records: Queue state and client-side retry views
conflict_action: Unknown outcome or duplicate/mismatched request blocks blind retry; reconcile before resubmission
operational_boundary: Exchange-side exactly-once behavior and every production submit route are not verified

authoritative_record: Venue-side order and execution records
canonical_source: External exchange API/account history
identity_version_binding: Venue order ID client order ID execution ID instrument and venue timestamp
derived_or_cached_records: Local accepted-fill events and order projections
conflict_action: Venue mismatch leaves local state unknown and requires reconciliation; local replay cannot override venue evidence
operational_boundary: No live venue connection or exchange record is established by local tests

authoritative_record: Reconciled position observation and durable position authorization
canonical_source: PositionAuthorityLedger derived from scoped REST/stream reconciliation
identity_version_binding: Symbol scope reconciliation hashes observed time and authorization fingerprint
conflict_action: RED UNKNOWN BLOCKED or mismatched positions become UNKNOWN and block new orders
operational_boundary: External exchange state remains the source observation; persistent ledger and live feed are required

authoritative_record: Venue/account statements plus reconciled local accounting reconstruction
canonical_source: External account records with local accounting invariants and replay
identity_version_binding: Account scope event offset snapshot version state hash and statement identity
derived_or_cached_records: Equity curves P&L views and replay projections
conflict_action: UNKNOWN or invariant mismatch blocks new risk until a new reconciliation is recorded
operational_boundary: Local ledger/replay is an audit reconstruction and does not override account records

authoritative_record: Scoped risk ledger and bound decision authorities
canonical_source: RiskBudgetLedger plus durable risk decision when configured
identity_version_binding: Portfolio strategy instrument scope budget version decision ID and expiry
conflict_action: Unknown reservation state or ceiling conflict blocks risk-increasing actions
operational_boundary: Current risk budget code does not prove a persistent platform-wide hard ceiling or correlated-exposure authority

authoritative_record: Configured secret backend
canonical_source: Explicit persistent credential backend or external secret manager
identity_version_binding: Credential ID version secret fingerprint and backend identity
derived_or_cached_records: In-memory secret handles and process-local resolved values
conflict_action: Backend/version conflict revokes or denies access; secrets never enter research data or audit payloads
operational_boundary: Production service identity and end-to-end external secret manager integration need independent evidence

authoritative_record: Trusted identity provider and externally provisioned reviewer key
canonical_source: External IAM or approved repository trust configuration
identity_version_binding: Principal ID role key fingerprint scope and approval timestamp
derived_or_cached_records: Actor labels and reviewer strings in records
conflict_action: Unknown or untrusted identity cannot authorize privileged action
operational_boundary: No reviewer identity/key is available in the project files and role assignment is not proven

authoritative_record: Runtime clock plus independently monitored host time source
canonical_source: Operating-system clock and configured synchronization service
identity_version_binding: UTC timestamp monotonic sequence and observed clock-health status
conflict_action: Naive stale or contradictory time invalidates freshness and TTL decisions
operational_boundary: Clock contracts exist but host synchronization and independent time-source proof are absent

authoritative_record: Remote GitHub commit refs pull request review and workflow run
canonical_source: Connected GitHub repository
identity_version_binding: Repository branch commit SHA PR head/base and workflow run ID
derived_or_cached_records: Local refs status badges and copied CI summaries
conflict_action: Remote SHA is shared branch state; local divergence requires fetch/compare before publication or merge
operational_boundary: Current observations are time-bound; branch protection and trusted reviewer policy require live GitHub verification

authoritative_record: Exact runner output bound to repository input hashes and commit
canonical_source: Fixed V4.29 runner JSON plus associated local or hosted run artifact
identity_version_binding: Run ID commit SHA manifest input hashes result and environment
conflict_action: Any hash/input mismatch invalidates the report for the current commit; rerun after changes
operational_boundary: Local .audit outputs are generated evidence outside the versioned source tree and do not establish external proof
